subject.title: fix(codex): align watchdog defer guards and add wall-clock ceiling (#99272)

question: Should the Codex absolute turn deadline derive from the effective run budget, or may this PR intentionally impose a universal 60-minute cap?
rationale: This choice changes timeout ownership and can newly terminate existing long-running workflows; repository history already treats explicit run budgets as a compatibility contract.

options.title: Derive From Run Budget
options.body: Compute the absolute deadline from the effective configured run budget and cover both shorter and longer budget cases.

options.title: Accept Fixed 60-Minute Cap
options.body: Intentionally cap every Codex app-server turn at 60 minutes with explicit compatibility documentation and live upgrade proof.

options.title: Defer Absolute Ceiling
options.body: Land only the agreed defer and progress corrections, then decide the permanent absolute deadline separately.

recommendation.title: Derive From Run Budget
recommendation.body: Compute the absolute deadline from the effective configured run budget and cover both shorter and longer budget cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties him to both the effective timeout-budget contract and the directly relevant completed-cache decision.
